text_block_list.text:
Air Groove misses out on victory at the 
Hanshin JF. Vowing to make this defeat 
count for the future, she turns her drive 
toward the next race.

A few days after the race. She had become 
the center of public attention, so much so 
that people debated every day over which 
race she would enter next.

Meanwhile, in order to become the ideal 
figure that so many Umamusume aspire to 
be, Air Groove—

Without a hint of hesitation, she declared 
her goal of pursuing the Triple Tiara 
route, running through all three races: 
the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
